maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from gym membership dues, franchise royalties and new equipment sales to franchisees, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Consumers pay monthly gym memberships; franchisees pay royalties and fees. No government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by franchisee-opened new clubs and membership growth, with only occasional franchise club acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Members can cancel and join another gym easily; low-cost memberships carry little switching cost or disruption.
